_: Single source of truth for the Oklab transform constants.
D10 locks Oklab to a hand-rolled implementation in BOTH languages rather than a
crate, so that golden-test parity is structural. That only holds if the constants
are provably the same on both sides — so they live here once, and the unit tests in
src/pipeline/oklab.test.ts and src-tauri/src/pipeline/oklab.rs each assert their own
literals against this file. Editing one implementation without the other fails a
test in the language that was not edited.
Values are Bjorn Ottosson's published Oklab matrices. Each decimal here parses to
the same IEEE-754 double in serde_json and in JavaScript, so 'same constants' means
the same bits, not merely the same digits.
